name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,978 on 12 Nov, down 11.1% over three months, beyond the 8% fall that marks Watch
state: Gold futures were near $3,978 early on 12 Nov, 11.1% lower over three months and 2.4% lower on the week, beyond the 8% three-month fall that marks Watch (Yahoo Finance). The price is about 25% below its 52-week high of $5,318. The largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 2.1%, and no single-week move approaches the 7% Alert line.
for_you: A falling gold price reflects ebbing demand for safe havens as Gulf hostilities pause and real interest rates stay high; it mainly affects holders of gold and jewellery prices.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
